title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Claims Manual: Benefit Authorizations and Reversals
content:
## Clauses in force

1. **Covered determination first.** A rider benefit under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons is authorized only after a covered determination is on file for the rider service request, as the request's handling history shows.
2. **Included septic pumping.** The included septic pumping pays the lower of the pumping invoice and the rider's septic pumping allowance, and never more than the rider's term cap less the rider benefit already paid in the term; it is paid once per term while the pumpings used in the term are below the rider's included pumpings per term, and only when a covered stoppage is caused by septic backup.
3. **One open resolution.** Only one repair, replacement or cash-in-lieu authorization is open per rider service request.
4. **Reversal.** An authorization is reversed in full when the work will not be performed, and never after completion.

## Retired clauses, in part

- **Repair or replace.** The clause that Bridgewell replaces the component when the repair estimate is at or above the repair-to-replace threshold rate times the replacement cost, when parts cannot be obtained within the parts lead time, or when it cannot be repaired, and otherwise repairs, is **no longer in force** for a repair or replacement under a rider; the authorized work cost is now set under the current basis.
- **Amount paid.** The clause that the amount paid on a repair, replacement or cash-in-lieu settlement is the lowest of the work's cost, the per-request cap less the rider benefit already paid on the request, and the term cap less the rider benefit paid in the term, is **no longer in force** for a repair or replacement authorization or for a cash settlement the customer takes, each of which is paid under its own current basis. Cash that Bridgewell itself offers is still paid at the lowest of the contracted replacement cost, the per-request cap less the repair, replacement and cash-in-lieu amounts already authorized on the request net of reversals, and the term cap less the rider benefit authorized in the term net of reversals.
- **Allowances.** The clause on allowances is **no longer in force** for the haul-away allowance on a replacement, whose amount is set under the current basis for the haul-away allowance. Every other allowance still pays as the clause says: the permit fee allowance, the refrigerant allowance on a sealed-system repair and the code violation allowance each pay the lower of the documented invoice amount and the allowance, once per type per request, and count toward the rider's term cap.
- **Cash in lieu.** The clause that cash in lieu equal to the contracted replacement cost within the same caps is offered when a like component cannot be sourced or the customer asks for cash in place of an authorized replacement is **no longer in force** for cash the customer asks for, which is now a cash settlement under the current basis. Cash that Bridgewell itself offers because a like component cannot be sourced is still settled as before: it is limited as stated under "Amount paid" above, must be accepted no later than the rider's cash-in-lieu offer validity period in calendar days after the offer, is paid within the rider's cash-in-lieu payment period in calendar days, and the replacement authorization it replaces is reversed in full.

## Septic pumping (hypothetical figures, Bridgewell Septic System Rider)

| Pumping invoice | Pumping allowance | Term cap remaining | Amount paid |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 300.00 | USD 350.00 | USD 500.00 | USD 300.00 |
| USD 420.00 | USD 350.00 | USD 500.00 | USD 350.00 |
| USD 420.00 | USD 350.00 | USD 200.00 | USD 200.00 |

## Allowances (hypothetical figures, Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider)

A permit invoice of USD 140.00 against a permit fee allowance of USD 100.00 pays USD 100.00; a code violation invoice of USD 180.00 against a code violation allowance of USD 250.00 pays USD 180.00. Both count toward the term cap.

## Cash Bridgewell offers (hypothetical figures, Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider, per-request cap and term cap USD 1500.00)

A like pool heater cannot be sourced; the contracted replacement cost is USD 1,300.00, nothing has been authorized on the request yet, and USD 400.00 of rider benefit has been authorized in the term, net. The cash offered is the lowest of 1,300.00, 1,500.00 and 1,100.00: USD 1,100.00.

superseded_clauses: Bridgewell replaces the component when repair_estimate is at or above repair_to_replace_threshold_rate times replacement_cost, when parts cannot be obtained within parts_lead_time_replace_days calendar days, or when it cannot be repaired, and otherwise repairs.

The amount paid on a repair, replacement or cash-in-lieu settlement is the lowest of the work's cost, per_request_cap less addon_msr_request_benefit_paid, and term_cap less addon_msr_term_benefit_paid.

Allowances (haul_away_allowance on a replacement, permit_fee_allowance, refrigerant_allowance on a sealed-system repair, code_violation_allowance) pay the lower of invoice_amount and the allowance, once per type per request, and count toward term_cap.

Cash in lieu equal to the contracted replacement_cost within the same caps is offered when a like component cannot be sourced or the customer asks for cash in place of an authorized replacement; it is the customer's decision, must be accepted no later than cash_in_lieu_offer_validity_days calendar days after the offer, is paid within cash_in_lieu_payment_days calendar days, and the replacement authorization it replaces is reversed in full.
